name: Podcast & Voice
author: Flubsound
description: Clear, even speech for podcasts, audiobooks, lectures and talk radio. Rumble and boxiness are removed, a light spectral gate lowers background hiss, a compressor and Auto Level at -16 LUFS keep every speaker at the same level, and a de-esser tames sibilance. The spectral gate runs only in the Quality latency profile, the suggested one; in Balanced and Low Latency everything else still applies.
